name: com.maps-agent/knowledge
title: Maps Agent
description: Google Maps and Business Profile know-how for local businesses: answers, guides, research.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything Maps Agent publishes about Google Maps and Google Business Profile for local businesses, in titles and in the full text of every page: answers, guides, research, glossary, blog, industry pages, the changelog and the site's own pages. Good for any question (getting more Google reviews, choosing a Business Profile category, a suspended profile, what changed this month). Returns ranked pages with id, title, one-line summary, form, last-updated date and URL; read one in full with fetch.

query.description: The question or keywords in plain English, e.g. 'how to get more Google reviews'.

form.description: Only this form. answer = one question answered first; guide = long reads, troubleshooting and copyable templates; research = our own measurements and statistics with method; glossary = terms; blog = articles; industry = what changes trade by trade; comparison = Maps Agent against other options; changelog = dated Google Business Profile changes; page = the site's other pages (pricing, the free audit, how it works, hubs).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one maps-agent.com page as markdown: title, canonical URL, last-updated date, the answer-first opening, the body with tables, FAQs and numbered sources. Works for any public page on the site, by the id search returns, a URL, a path or a slug. Read body_markdown for the text and pass part to continue a long page. Set detail to text to place the body in the text block.

id.description: A maps-agent.com page URL (https://maps-agent.com/answers/how-to-get-more-google-reviews), a site path (/glossary/citation) or a slug or id from search / list_articles.

part.description: Which part to read, starting at 1. The first part gives the contents of a longer page.

detail.description: Where to put the markdown: structuredContent.body_markdown (default) or the text content block.

form.description: Which form a bare slug belongs to, when the same slug exists in more than one.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: What Maps Agent has published, newest first. Without a form: how many pages each form has. With a form: its pages with title, summary, topic, date and URL, optionally narrowed by a topic word (an answer cluster such as 'reviews', a trade such as 'dentists', a guide kind such as 'template').

form.description: answer = one question answered first; guide = long reads, troubleshooting and copyable templates; research = our own measurements and statistics with method; glossary = terms; blog = articles; industry = what changes trade by trade; comparison = Maps Agent against other options; changelog = dated Google Business Profile changes; page = the site's other pages (pricing, the free audit, how it works, hubs).

topic.description: A word to narrow by topic or title, e.g. 'reviews', 'suspension', 'dentists'.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: The Maps Agent glossary definition of a Google Maps, Google Business Profile or local SEO term (e.g. 'primary category', 'local citation', 'map pack', 'review gating', 'service area business'), with the URL of the full entry. Falls back to the closest answers when the glossary has no entry.

term.description: The term in plain words, e.g. 'Google Business Profile category'.

tools.name: get_research
tools.description: One Maps Agent research or statistics page: the findings with the method behind them (instrument, dataset, sample size, time window, population, exclusions, provenance), its key figures, sources and datasets as data. A statistics page gathers published studies: its method lives with each source, so method is null and sources carry the studies. Read body_markdown for the text and pass part to continue a long page. Set detail to text to place the body in the text block. Without a ref: the list of published studies.

ref.description: A research page URL, path or slug; omit to list the studies.

part.description: Which part to read, starting at 1. The first part gives the contents of a longer page.

detail.description: Where to put the markdown: structuredContent.body_markdown (default) or the text content block.

tools.name: find_categories
tools.description: Look up Google's official US English Business Profile category names and IDs for a trade or business type, such as 'plumber' or 'pediatric dentist'. Includes the date of the Google catalog and Maps Agent's public industry guidance for a matching trade when available.

query.description: The business type or category name, e.g. 'plumber'.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Dated changes to Google Business Profile, Google Maps and local Search from the Maps Agent changelog, newest first, each with its date, what changed, the source to open and our story when we wrote one. Good for 'what did Google change in Business Profiles since November 1'. Pass since (YYYY-MM-DD) for changes on or after a day.

since.description: Only changes on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-11-01'. Omit for the whole changelog.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: The Maps Agent plans with their monthly price, what each includes, whether a plan can be started now or has a waitlist, the next step and the page to take it on maps-agent.com, and the billing terms (month to month, refunds, cancelling). Good for 'how much does Maps Agent cost and can I start now'.

tools.name: audit_business
tools.description: Start a free Google Maps visibility audit using the exact business name, city, region, country and Google Maps place ID. Returns the existing monthly report or a report_id and a link when a new audit starts. Call again with only report_id to check whether the report is ready.

business_name.description: The exact business name on Google Maps.

report_id.description: The ID returned by a previous call to check that audit.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report missing data, a data error or a request to Maps Agent. Send only when the user wants to share feedback. Do not include personal details or client data.

message.description: A short report. Include a public page or tool name if relevant.
